content: iOS audio interruptions (calls/Siri/other apps) fire via AVAudioSession interruption notifications; the audio_session Flutter package exposes interruptionEventStream distinguishing pause/duck/unknown. Known bug: mic fails to reactivate after a call interruption ends (AVFAudio -10868) unless session is properly reconfigured/reactivated. Recording must auto-pause on interruption began and only auto-resume on interruption ended if appropriate category options are set.
